items.key: A task whose steps are known in advance and the same every time (for example, cancelling a booking: look it up, cancel it, free the slot, notify the student). Code can run it with fewer model calls, so it is cheaper and faster, and it is more predictable, because the steps cannot be skipped, reordered or looped.

answers.claude-haiku-5-5: A fixed workflow is better for a task with known, repeated steps, such as the booking flow, because it is predictable and cheaper; reasons: it is easier to test and audit, and it uses fewer model calls and less latency
